group_note: same core + 指间mud mobile protocol. This is the ONE 'limited' status in this family that reflects a real, still-current caveat (not staleness, unlike siblings zhongjidiyu (052)/zjdyaryl (053), both corrected to playable this pass): this port's logind.lpc gates every connection behind a custom crypt-based client-version handshake designed for the '指间' (fingertip/mobile) client, not a generic telnet/web-terminal session. The server sends 'ver1.0,<crypt(ZJKEY,"zj")>' and expects the client to reply with crypt(ZJKEY, <that string>[2..3]) -- confirmed this pass that the handshake IS fully deterministic and passable (this driver's crypt() matches standard libc DES-crypt exactly, verified by reproducing the server's own challenge value with Python's crypt module and computing a reply that the server accepted, '版本验证成功'), and a second custom protocol step follows: a single input line combining id║password║crypt(ZJKEY,id)+crypt(ZJKEY,password)║email (║ = U+2551). Completing both steps by hand reaches full gameplay cleanly (admin login confirmed, '目前权限：(admin)', quit clean) -- but the GENERIC WASM web terminal this project ships (a plain telnet-alike) cannot compute these values automatically, so an ordinary visitor clicking into this lib's page cannot get past the first prompt without external tooling. Also fixed the same real bug as its siblings: clone/user/login.lpc's query_save_file() empty-string guard (id == "" as well as !stringp(id)) to stop a %c/sprintf crash on the very first connection.
